cue: Applying exact independent-set metric KPZ to an h-selected random set without a separate independence or dependent-set theorem
fire_when: Unrestricted KPZ applied to X=T_h^gamma predicts Euclidean dimension 2 instead of 2-gamma^2/2.
silent_when: Use metric KPZ on a deterministic set or a random set sampled independently of h; or use the dedicated thick-point theorem with deterministic ambient set.
text: Before applying exact metric KPZ, check how the set was chosen. Gamma-thick points depend on h: independent-set KPZ gives 2, but their Euclidean dimension is 2-gamma^2/2. Use the dedicated thick-point theorem or a valid dependence argument.
